resources.string:
Paninda needs its own workbook with fixed worksheet names and headers in row 1, starting at A1.

Compatibility detection for existing spreadsheets is not available yet. This notice appears for every connection; it does not mean a problem was detected.

Proceed creates a separate “Paninda Workbench” workbook in your Google Drive and uploads the records saved on this device. Your other files stay untouched.

This notice appears for every connection. Automatic compatibility detection for other spreadsheets is not available yet.

Paninda will read this saved Paninda workbook using its fixed worksheet names and row-1 headers. Please keep those headers in their original order, starting at A1.

If this device and the workbook have different unsynced changes, the connection will stop for review. No automatic merge or overwrite will be attempted.

The connection could not be completed. Your local records are still on this device.

Check your internet connection and Google account, then try again. Setup will restart from Google authorization and workbook selection.

If Google created a workbook before the connection failed, it may still appear in Drive. Review it before creating another.

Both this device and the workbook contain changes that cannot be combined automatically. Neither copy has been replaced.\n\nReview the workbook and keep this device’s records. You can reconnect to the original workbook or create a separate workbook from your local records. Conflict suggestions are also available in Settings.

The workbook does not match Paninda’s data contract. Nothing was imported into this device.\n\nRestore the original worksheet names, row-1 headers and valid field values, then retry. Keep a copy of the workbook before making repairs. You can also create a separate workbook using the records on this device.

Google could not authorize this installation. The project owner needs to enable the Drive and Sheets APIs and register this app’s package and signing certificate as an Android OAuth client.\n\nYour local records are safe. Retry after the Cloud Console setup is complete.
Google denied access. Check the selected account, requested permissions, OAuth test-user list and enabled APIs. Your local records are preserved.\n\nRetry to request authorization again.

This workbook is no longer accessible. It may have been deleted or its sharing permissions may have changed. Local records are preserved.\n\nRestore access, or disconnect in Settings and select another Paninda workbook.
Google’s request limit was reached. Your local changes are still pending. Wait a moment, then try again.

Google may have received the upload, but its result could not be confirmed. Local records and pending changes have been kept.\n\nReview the workbook, then retry sync. Paninda will read both copies again before continuing. Avoid editing the workbook while a sync is running.
